description: Defines synchronization primitives including a mutex wrapper (QuicheLockImpl) and a notification class (QuicheNotificationImpl) for the quiche networking library, with platform-specific macros and class declarations.

classes.name: QuicheLockImpl
classes.description: A class wrapping a non-reentrant mutex with methods for exclusive and shared locking.

classes.name: QuicheNotificationImpl
classes.description: A class providing thread notification via a waitable event.

methods.name: QuicheLockImpl
methods.description: Default constructor for the lock wrapper.

methods.name: WriterLock
methods.description: Acquires the lock exclusively, blocking until available.

methods.name: ReaderLock
methods.description: Acquires a shared lock, blocking until available.

methods.name: AssertReaderHeld
methods.description: Asserts that a shared lock is held (not implemented).

methods.name: HasBeenNotified
methods.description: Checks if the event has been signaled.

methods.name: Notify
methods.description: Signals the event to notify waiting threads.

methods.name: WaitForNotification
methods.description: Blocks until the event is signaled.
